result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other per-rep counts.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarterly purchase-order query uses. I also added "cancelled purchase orders are not counted" to its Javadoc, in the same wording as the sibling methods.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` and `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` pass offline. Neither test has a cancelled purchase order in its data, so the exclusion itself is not covered by a test. I did not add one, to keep the change small. Nothing was committed.
